My youngest sister is in year 3 and so far we have done 3 days of homeschooling. I work full time and try to support her at the same time. There are many challenges so far. For example, as she is quite young, she does struggle focusing for long periods of time and also does need support when using the laptop as she is yet to fully be IT literate. As a young child she also asks many questions, often before fully thinking of the answer herself. She is a bright student and when she puts a bit of thought into it, she does have the answers, but she needs to learn to think before being told to. By far the biggest challenge is that I cannot provide her 100% of my attention. She understands fully that I will provide the support if and when she needs it, but since I work, she also must feel alone and works independently. There have been positives. Due to this situation, we are able to spend time together and have both shown patience towards each other. I have definitely learnt a lot from having to be patient to also better understanding how she learns best. I am very lucky to have an amazing student.
